TEST 34: URL parsing
  url=http://example.com/path?query=val#frag is_connect=0 result=0
  field_set=0x3b port=0
    SCHEMA=http
    HOST=example.com
    PATH=/path
    QUERY=query=val
    FRAGMENT=frag
  url=http://user:pass@host.com:8080/p/a/t/h?q=1 is_connect=0 result=0
  field_set=0x5f port=8080
    SCHEMA=http
    HOST=host.com
    PORT=8080
    PATH=/p/a/t/h
    QUERY=q=1
    USERINFO=user:pass
  url=/status?format=json is_connect=0 result=0
  field_set=0x18 port=0
    PATH=/status
    QUERY=format=json
  url=http://[::1]:8080/ipv6 is_connect=0 result=0
  field_set=0xf port=8080
    SCHEMA=http
    HOST=::1
    PORT=8080
    PATH=/ipv6
  url=example.com:443 is_connect=1 result=0
  field_set=0x6 port=443
    HOST=example.com
    PORT=443
  url=http://example.com is_connect=0 result=0
  field_set=0x3 port=0
    SCHEMA=http
    HOST=example.com
  url=/ is_connect=0 result=0
  field_set=0x8 port=0
    PATH=/
  url=/path/to/resource is_connect=0 result=0
  field_set=0x8 port=0
    PATH=/path/to/resource
